title: Planning-content reader
responsibility: Be the single path by which the application reads planning content from disk, applying the DEC-0019 contract on every read: await `connection()` before the filesystem access, inside a `<Suspense>` boundary whose fallback is a real loading state for that content. Everything the shell knows about the plan enters through here.
notes: ⚠️ PLANNED, NOT BUILT (2026-08-27). `implementedBy` is absent, and its absence is the only signal in this artifact that says so — the same convention CMP-0011 established, and the same hazard QST-0015 named: creating these records takes the orphan count to zero while nothing exists. 'Every requirement traces to a component' becomes true; 'the shell works' does not. ⚠️ OUTSIDE ITS BOUNDARY: it does not parse artifacts, derive verdicts or compile documents — it supplies content and the freshness guarantee, and the modules that interpret content are `lib/`'s, reached through CMP-adapter. ⚠️ IT IS THE THING REQ-0021 CONFINES READS TO. AST-0022 measured that a read bypassing this component is served FRESH whenever a compliant read shares its route, so a bypass is invisible to any behavioural test — which is why the confinement is static and why this component's value depends on nothing being able to go around it. ⚠️ BUILT 2026-08-27 BY TSK-0005. `implementedBy` says code exists. ACC-0016 stays `not-evaluated` and that is correct rather than cautious: it measures independent `<Suspense>` boundaries in the stage view, and the stage view does not exist until TSK-0009. What this task delivers is the SHAPE those boundaries need — the criteria read and the document read are separate exports, so neither can be made to wait on the other. ⚠️ THREE READS, EACH AWAITING `connection()` FIRST: the project overview, one stage's criteria, and one stage's document. Measured under a production build as `ƒ` — dynamic — while `/`, which reads nothing, stayed `○` static in the same build. ⚠️ NOTHING HERE IMPORTS `lib/` OR TOUCHES `node:fs`; every read goes through `app/server/*`. A static test enforces that today, and it is explicitly a STAND-IN for REQ-0021's real check (TSK-0006, TSK-0015) rather than a substitute for it: it covers one directory by pattern, not the application, and it does not follow indirect re-export chains.
